swift.name: Xcode Command Line Tools
swift.description: Apple official development tools, providing Swift compiler and basic development libraries
swift.installGuide: Run the above command in the terminal, an installation window will pop up, follow the prompts to complete the installation. The installation process may take several minutes to tens of minutes, please wait patiently.

brew.name: Homebrew
brew.description: Package manager for macOS, used to install and manage software packages
brew.installGuide: Run the above command in the terminal, follow the prompts to complete the installation. If the network is slow, you can use a domestic mirror source.

macfuse.name: MacFUSE
macfuse.description: File system user space framework, required by ntfs-3g
macfuse.installGuide: MacFUSE is the foundation for NTFS mounting. Intel Macs: sudo port install macfuse. Apple Silicon: brew install --cask macfuse. Allow the system extension after installing.

ntfs3g.name: ntfs-3g
ntfs3g.description: NTFS file system driver, providing NTFS read-write support
ntfs3g.installGuide: Install ntfs-3g to mount NTFS volumes read-write. Intel Mac: sudo port install ntfs-3g (installs MacFUSE automatically). Apple Silicon: brew tap gromgit/homebrew-fuse && brew install ntfs-3g-mac

ntfs3g.brokenWarning: ntfs-3g {version} has a known regression: creating new files or directories fails with "Invalid argument". This was fixed in {recommended} — please update to {recommended} or later.
ntfs3g.notFoundWarning: The ntfs-3g executable was not found. Mounting depends on it — please install it first.

help.title: Guide

quickStart.1: 1. On the Dependencies tab, confirm MacFUSE and ntfs-3g are installed. Expand an entry to see install commands.
quickStart.2: 2. On the NTFS Devices tab, click "Mount" on the target device and approve the system authorization prompt.
quickStart.3: 3. The volume appears under /Volumes and is now writable. Use "Unmount" to return it to read-only.

macPorts.1: Intel Macs have no official Homebrew support, so use MacPorts (installed in /opt/local):
macPorts.2: This app automatically detects executables under /opt/local/bin — no extra configuration needed.

about.1: NTFSMount is a native macOS app for reading and writing NTFS volumes, powered by macFUSE + ntfs-3g.
about.2: Built on SwiftUI, IOKit and DiskArbitration: the interface, device detection and the mounting pipeline all use system frameworks, with no third-party runtime.
about.3: Device detection uses native system APIs (IOKit / statfs); idle CPU usage is near zero.

help.trouble.1: • "Windows is hibernated": Windows Fast Startup is on. Plug the drive back into Windows and run shutdown /s /t 0 to fully shut down.
help.trouble.2: • "Resource busy": a program is using the device. Use the "Reset" action, or close the program and retry.
help.trouble.3: • "ntfs-3g not found": verify it is installed and that /opt/local/bin (MacPorts) or /usr/local/bin is in the search path.
help.trouble.4: • Permission denied: allow the MacFUSE system extension in System Settings → Privacy & Security.

settings.title: Application Settings
settings.autoMountDesc: When enabled, NTFS devices connected later are mounted read-write automatically. Devices already attached at launch are handled by "Mount read-write at startup"
settings.enableLogsDesc: Disabled by default, requires manual activation. When enabled, the app will record all operation logs. When disabled, new logs will not be recorded, but previously recorded logs will still be retained. Logs are saved for a maximum of 30 days by default
settings.resetLogsDailyDesc: When enabled, the app will automatically clear the previous day's logs on the first launch each day
settings.exportLogsDesc: Export all operation logs as a text file
settings.preventSleepDesc: When enabled, the system will prevent entering sleep mode to ensure devices remain accessible
settings.preventSleepOn: Sleep prevention enabled — the Mac will not idle-sleep.
settings.preventSleepFailed: Could not create the power assertion; sleep prevention was not enabled.
settings.autoStartDesc: When enabled, the app will automatically launch when the system starts
settings.autoStartApproval: Needs your approval in System Settings → General → Login Items & Extensions.
settings.launchAtLoginOff: NTFSMount will no longer start at login.
settings.launchAtLoginFailed: Could not change the login item
settings.silentLaunchDesc: When enabled, the app starts with only a menu bar icon and does not open the main window
settings.mountOnLaunchDesc: Automatically mounts NTFS devices already attached at launch as read-write. Requires administrator privileges; if an administrator password is saved, no authorization dialog appears
settings.savePasswordDesc: Stores your administrator password in the macOS keychain so mounting no longer shows the system authorization dialog. Note: this is less secure than typing it each time — the app submits it on your behalf. Turning this switch off deletes the saved password
settings.passwordStored: Saved to the keychain — mounting no longer shows the authorization dialog
settings.passwordNotStored: No password saved yet — the system authorization dialog still appears
settings.passwordSaveFailed: Could not write to the keychain
settings.passwordSaved: Administrator password saved to the keychain
settings.passwordInvalidated: The saved administrator password is no longer valid (your login password may have changed). It has been deleted; the system authorization dialog will be used instead
settings.deletePasswordConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the saved password?
settings.deletePasswordError: Failed to delete password, please try again

ioSize.desc: The I/O block size macFUSE uses when accessing the volume. macFUSE defaults to 64 KiB; the official documentation notes that larger values reduce access overhead significantly on local storage. Use a smaller value for mechanical drives or many small files

settings.startupTabDesc: Select the default tab to display when the app starts
settings.trayModeDesc: When enabled, closing the window will minimize to the system tray instead of quitting the app. You can quickly manage NTFS devices through the tray icon.
settings.windowSizeDesc: Customize the width and height of the application window (in pixels). Changes will take effect after restarting the application
